objective: Review the native Verilator parser-stub validation and handoff boundary before defining a non-executing parser-stub fixture.

review_decision.reason: The definition assigns unknown accelerator validation to the parser-stub validation contract, keeps current Python argparse choices as wrapper compatibility only, pins the structured sidecar handoff fields, and keeps execution, target registry lookup, source closure, coverage manifest selection, host-probe metadata, state materialization, and comparison outside the native parser stub.
review_decision.weakest_point: This is still contract-only. The repository still has no Verilator source tree or parser patch, and today's observable unknown-accelerator rejection still happens through wrapper argparse choices rather than a parser-stub validation fixture. The next gate must define a non-executing fixture that makes this contract testable before any native parser support claim.

required_next_gate.name: define_verilator_native_option_parser_stub_fixture_gate
must_define: a non-executing parser-stub fixture input and output contract
a fixture case that accepts --sim-accel sidecar-gpu with --sim-accel-states 64 and --sim-accel-steps 1
a fixture case that rejects an unknown accelerator through the parser-stub validation contract, not wrapper argparse choices
fixture cases that reject missing shape halves, non-positive counts, and mixed native shape spellings through the stub contract or a shared sidecar option mapper
preservation of ordinary Verilator inputs such as --cc, --timing, -Mdir, --top-module, source files, filelists, defines, include directories, warning flags, and other Verilator arguments
the serialized handoff fields for accelerator mode, state count, step count, preserved Verilator args, source boundary references, state/report naming rules, correctness policy, and non-claims
how the fixture remains independent of an actual Verilator source tree
why the fixture adds no execution, measurement, runtime/ABI change, parser implementation, arbitrary filelist support, dependency inference, or automatic allocation claim
must_not_claim: Verilator source patch landed in this repository

non_claims: not a native Verilator parser implementation
not parser inference of coverage manifests, host-probe metadata, source closure, state paths, or report paths
not automatic optimal GPU allocation for any design
not a runtime or ABI change
not a new public CLI or workflow
not GEM benchmark or comparison evidence
reports and artifacts are generated evidence, not source of truth
